technology_name: A Micronutrient Composition for Cardamom and a Process for Its Preparation
description: Micronutrient composition developed for cardamom cultivation to support balanced nutrition and crop growth. The formulation is intended for nutrient management in cardamom production systems.
applications:
Micronutrient fertilizer and specialty plant nutrition manufacturers
Cardamom cultivation and plantation enterprises
Agricultural input companies and crop nutrition service providers
Farmer producer organizations (FPOs) and spice grower cooperatives
Government agriculture departments and spice productivity enhancement programs
